articles.title: The crypto reader's guide to the 2026 midterm election: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: America is going to the polls, and the results will shape crypto legislation and regulation over the next two years. Here's what to know.

articles.title: AI agents bypassed crypto spending limits without human approval, researchers find in a new test
articles.snippet: The researchers say any approval an agent can reach is unreliable, and they built Countersign, an app tying approval to a physical action the agent can’t fake.

articles.title: The key races to watch for the 2026 election
articles.snippet: While crypto isn't a major issue in the 2026 election, the industry will be shaped by who takes office in January. Here are the main races CoinDesk is tracking.

articles.title: Crypto card startups are racking up losses just to buy your loyalty with big rewards
articles.snippet: Providers are betting trading, lending and staking revenue can cover rewards and turn card users into profitable customers.

articles.title: Crypto PACs made big Republican push in final weeks before November 3 election
articles.snippet: Even as polling and online wagers put Democrats at a high chance to claim greater power in Congress, the industry's high-profile support has gone the other direction.
